title: Registration
description: Secure your spot at SAGAR2027 by registering. Our registration process is secure and hassle-free, ensuring a smooth experience for you.

notes.title: Note:
list: Registration is valid for UG/PG and PhD students with valid Id card, Academician and Industry persons.
At least one author registration is mandatory for each accepted paper.
Co-authors who wish to attend the conference in offline mode must register under the Attendee category.
